Subject: Preflight: April 28 Acme Analytics live demo — platform & sponsor checks

Hi team,

Acme Analytics (live demo + sponsor) is scheduled for Wed Apr 28 at 10am PT. We need a tight preflight and a clear handoff for sponsor creative and recording rights. Key asks below — please reply with owners and short confirmations by end of day Thursday 4/15.

Preflight high-level: 
- Platform mapping: primary = Zoom webinar (10k registrants cap), fallback = ON24 simulcast (RTMP ingest). Confirm ingest keys + playback test windows.
- Registration form: remove unnecessary PII fields, include SSO link for enterprise registrants (Acme requested SSO token flow). Need final field list.
- Recording & reuse rights: sponsor wants the session clip for paid social. Need signed release from Acme and final logo placement approval.
- Captions & transcript: we need CC vendor on standby; ensure output srt + text transcript delivered.
- Backup plan: secondary RTMP to Akamai / CDN; playback verification 24h post-event.
- Run-of-show: include sponsor ad slate (15s) and a 30s pre-roll sponsor mention.

Attachments: run_of_show_v1.pdf (draft) — I'll attach updated run-of-show after owners confirmed.

I can own the recording permission thread to Acme and DocuSign signoff. Lauren — can you take platform check (ingest keys + fallback)? Vanessa — can you own sponsor creative / logo placement? Marissa — registration fields and SSO integration?

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I took the platform owner. Attached is an updated preflight (preflight_checklist_v3.xlsx) with owners and timeboxed checks. Highlights below: 

Platform checklist (owner / status):
- Primary Zoom webinar: verify host account limits + webinar licenses (me) / scheduled by 4/20 (in progress)
- RTMP fallback: prepare ON24 ingest and spare RTMP to CDN (me)
- Ingest keys: request keys from ON24 + test ingest window scheduled 4/22 9–10am PT (confirmed)
- Playback verification: record local + cloud, run playback test across US/EU regions 4/29 (post-event)
- Latency test: measure 1-way latency and captions timing during rehearsal (me / ops)

Registration form notes (Marissa): drop "Company size" & "Phone" fields; keep email, first+last name, job title, country, and opt-in checkbox for recording reuse. For SSO flow, Acme requires SAML redirect; recommend we send SSO token param via registration confirmation URL.

Security / data note: Zoom cloud recording will be set to private until DocuSign release is complete. If Acme needs early access, we'll do a secure S3 transfer with temporary signed URL.

I've included quick owner timings in the workbook. Vanessa — I flagged sponsor asset deadlines (4/19 EOD) so we can finalize slate.

-Lauren
Senior Events Lead
Redwood Inference

-- Forwarded for Acme ops & Natalie --

Hi Natalie / Acme team,

Thanks again for partnering on the April 28 demo. Quick confirmations we need from you to finalize the run-of-show and recording release: 

1) Recording permissions: Acme agrees to a limited release allowing Redwood + Sponsor to use up to 3x 60s marketing clips across social paid placements, plus the full session for gated on-demand playback. Please confirm "yes" and provide signatory name + title. We will prepare a DocuSign release that covers: reuse length, territory, and duration (12 months).

2) Sponsor creative: final logo (SVG/PNG), 16:9 pre-roll video (15s), and sponsor bio (50 words). Deadline: 4/19 EOD. Attached: sponsor_asset_specs.zip (asset specs + sample slate).

3) Registrant SSO: you asked for SAML-based SSO for internal registrants. We can append a token param to the confirmation URL; can your SSO team provide the SAML endpoint or an SP-initiated metadata file by 4/19?

4) Playback access: do you prefer public on-demand with opt-in gated form, or gated behind a CID? State preference so we can configure the embed and retention.

If you confirm (1) we will send DocuSign immediately and hold cloud recording as private until executed.

Appreciate a quick reply — we have rehearsal 4/22 9am PT (platform ingest test).

Best,
Irene
